title: 口语练习
subtitle: 每天 10 分钟 · 共 5 天
steps: 点 🔊 听一遍，听清语调
一句一句跟着读，声音要大，不怕错
读完点「今天完成了」打卡

sentences.zh: 亚历山大·贝尔在 1876 年发明了它。

sentences.en: Paper was invented in ancient China.
sentences.zh: 纸是在中国古代发明的。

sentences.en: A new idea can lead to a great invention.
sentences.zh: 一个新点子可以带来伟大的发明。

sentences.en: Many schools can afford a 3D printer now.
sentences.zh: 现在许多学校买得起 3D 打印机了。

sentences.en: The high-speed train speeds up our trips.
sentences.zh: 高铁让我们的出行更快了。

sentences.en: The Wright brothers built a glider before their plane.
sentences.zh: 莱特兄弟在造飞机之前先造了滑翔机。

sentences.en: Later on, the skill spread to many countries.
sentences.zh: 后来，这项技术传到了许多国家。

sentences.en: I would like to invent something useful.
sentences.zh: 我想发明一样有用的东西。
